import os
import subprocess
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, abort
import psycopg2
import hashlib
import hmac

app = Flask(__name__)

DB_HOST = os.environ.get('DB_HOST', 'localhost')
DB_NAME = os.environ.get('DB_NAME', 'appdb')
DB_USER = os.environ.get('DB_USER', 'appuser')
DB_PASS = os.environ.get('DB_PASS', 'secret')
HMAC_KEY = os.environ.get('HMAC_KEY', 'default-hmac-key')

def get_db():
    return psycopg2.connect(host=DB_HOST, dbname=DB_NAME, user=DB_USER, password=DB_PASS)

@app.route('/api/reports/generate', methods=['POST'])
def generate_report():
    """Generate a PDF report using wkhtmltopdf with user-specified parameters."""
    data = request.get_json()
    if not data:
        abort(400, 'Missing JSON body')
    
    report_id = data.get('report_id', '')
    title = data.get('title', 'Untitled')
    # User can specify a custom header/footer URL for branding
    header_url = data.get('header_url', '')
    footer_text = data.get('footer_text', 'Confidential')
    
    # Validate report exists in DB
    conn = get_db()
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT content_path FROM reports WHERE id = %s", (report_id,))
    row = cur.fetchone()
    cur.close()
    conn.close()
    
    if not row:
        abort(404, 'Report not found')
    
    content_path = row[0]
    output_path = f'/tmp/report_{report_id}.pdf'
    
    # Build wkhtmltopdf command
    cmd = ['wkhtmltopdf', '--quiet', '--enable-local-file-access']
    
    if header_url:
        # Allow custom header HTML from URL
        cmd.extend(['--header-html', header_url])
    
    cmd.extend([
        '--footer-center', footer_text,
        '--footer-font-size', '8',
        content_path,
        output_path
    ])
    
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, timeout=30, text=True)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            return jsonify({'error': 'PDF generation failed', 'detail': result.stderr[:200]}), 500
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Timeout generating PDF'}), 504
    
    return jsonify({'status': 'ok', 'path': output_path})


@app.route('/api/reports/fetch-template', methods=['POST'])
def fetch_template():
    """Fetch a report template from an internal or external URL for preview."""
    data = request.get_json()
    url = data.get('url', '')
    
    if not url:
        abort(400, 'Missing url parameter')
    
    # Basic SSRF protection - block obvious internal ranges
    # Note: This is intentionally incomplete for metadata endpoints
    blocked = ['127.0.0.1', '0.0.0.0', '::1', 'localhost']
    from urllib.parse import urlparse
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    if parsed.hostname in blocked:
        abort(403, 'Blocked host')
    
    import requests as http_client
    try:
        resp = http_client.get(url, timeout=5, allow_redirects=True)
        return jsonify({'status_code': resp.status_code, 'body': resp.text[:5000]})
    except Exception as e:
        return jsonify({'error': str(e)}), 502


@app.route('/api/health', methods=['GET'])
def health():
    return jsonify({'status': 'healthy'})


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080)
